header: Department words with more than one meaning, RESOLVED instead of asked (step 55a, my decisions of 26 Oct 2026, after I read the old intranet's lists of both departments). Before, the question used to ASK which department was meant (step 49a). Now I resolve it: "refractory" = ALL THREE rows: REFRACTORY (86000), REFRACTORY (OFFICE) (86030) and COKE OVEN REFRACTORY (86600), exactly as the old intranet's Refractory page (24 people). Coke Oven Refractory also belongs to CO & CC (the 5 people of code 86600 are on both lists), and the answer says so. "garage" / "plant garage" = the PLANT GARAGE: ALL SIX rows, named by name and code (85000, 85070, 85110, 85200, 85330, 85430), so the exact-rows check (namedRows.ts) forces the SQL to select them all. Before step 55d I only turned the bare word into "plant garage", which is just a hint to the model, so it could select the single row called PLANT GARAGE (it did: 9 executives). (the old text:) = the PLANT GARAGE (all six rows). The TOWNSHIP garage has no employees at all (no row in the HR list, an empty department in the old intranet): it is a CLOSED department, and a question about it is answered at once ("Township Garage has no employees: it is a closed department."). I make the rewritten question name the rows by name and code ("REFRACTORY (code 86000), ..."), the form step 49b already enforces exactly, so the model cannot pick other rows. A rule fires only when the question is about people (or is just a word or two) and does not already say which department it means (a code, "coke oven refractory", "refractory office", "plant garage", "M.H.E.M.D." ...). I never touch a document question ("the tender for the new garage building"). To add a word, add a rule here: it is the only place.

members.name: question
doc: I search for this question instead of the one typed: the word is replaced by the rows it means.

members.name: note
doc: A short sentence I show under the answer. It may hold {{coke}}, which finishDepartmentNote fills in.

members.name: closed
doc: I answer at once and search nothing: this department is closed.

members.name: cokeOven
doc: The note needs the number of Coke Oven Refractory people (code 86600), so the caller counts them and calls finishDepartmentNote.
